name: Shikoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated
summary: Shikoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in generating, transmitting, distributing, and selling electricity in Japan and internationally. The company generates electricity through nuclear, thermal, hydro, solar, and other sources. It is also involved in the telecommunication and information system services; cable TV broadcasting; studying, designing, engineering, and maintenance of electricity-related facilities; planning and designing of civil engineering and construction; engineering work for power supply facilities; and sales and engineering of electric water heaters and air-conditioning systems.
